notValidated: No Wealth-Lab backtest or economic out-of-sample validation. Formalized variants need visual review.

coverage.Name: EMA order
coverage.Rule: 1 if E20>E50>E100>E200; price above E20 recorded separately

coverage.Name: EMA rising
coverage.Rule: Fraction of four one-bar EMA slopes >0

coverage.Name: Stable growth
coverage.Rule: Order + rising slopes + C>E20 + all breadth>=50 + ATRP1<=2, observed streak/5 capped at 1

coverage.Name: Fast EMA falling
coverage.Rule: E20 falling with E50/100/200 rising OR E20/50 falling with E100/200 rising

coverage.Name: EMA fan
coverage.Rule: Positive EMA adjacent gaps + positive C-E20, divided by C and 10%, clipped to 1

coverage.Name: Compressed fan
coverage.Rule: Bull order and (E20-E200)/C<=2%

coverage.Name: Below all EMA
coverage.Rule: C below all four EMA

coverage.Name: Drawdown depth
coverage.Rule: Drawdown from trailing 252-close peak /20%, clipped to 1

coverage.Name: Down waves
coverage.Rule: Down-leg starts with >=1% drop in last 20 bars /3; new leg after >=1% rebound

coverage.Name: Loaded-history drawdown
coverage.Rule: Drawdown from loaded-history close peak /20%; NOT asserted true all-time high

coverage.Name: EMA breaks down
coverage.Rule: Fraction of four close-vs-own-day-EMA downward crosses

coverage.Name: EMA wick support
coverage.Rule: Fraction of EMA with L<EMA and C>=EMA

coverage.Name: Double EMA break
coverage.Rule: C yesterday>=E20/E50 yesterday, today below both

coverage.Name: EMA50 grace
coverage.Rule: EMA20 break episode age<=4, no close below EMA50; resets on C>=EMA20

coverage.Name: EMA reclaim
coverage.Rule: Fraction of four upward close/EMA crosses

coverage.Name: EMA pair crosses
coverage.Rule: (up crosses-down crosses)/4 for 20/50,50/100,100/200,50/200

coverage.Name: Failed EMA100 rebound
coverage.Rule: Down cross E100 after C between E100 and E50 and prior C<E100 within 20 bars

coverage.Name: RSI lower saturation
coverage.Rule: Fraction of RSI 14/8 and 10/8 <=-0.999; NOT automatic buy

coverage.Name: RSI upper saturation
coverage.Rule: Fraction >=0.999; NOT automatic sell

coverage.Name: RSI lower release
coverage.Rule: Fraction crossing up from <=-0.999 to >-0.999

coverage.Name: RSI upper release
coverage.Rule: Fraction crossing down from >=0.999 to <0.999

coverage.Name: RSI zero crosses
coverage.Rule: (up zero crosses-down zero crosses)/2

coverage.Name: Fast RSI leads
coverage.Rule: Fast RSI>0 and slow RSI<=0; observed zero-cross lag recorded

coverage.Name: RSI joint saturation
coverage.Rule: +1 both upper, -1 both lower, 0 otherwise

coverage.Name: Both RSI leave upper
coverage.Rule: Both yesterday>=0.999 and both today<0.999

coverage.Name: Breadth level
coverage.Rule: Mean of four breadth closes /100; individual values also retained

coverage.Name: Breadth washout
coverage.Rule: Mean clipped low memberships: B50 3..8, B100 7..12, B200 10..20

coverage.Name: Breadth rising
coverage.Rule: Fraction of four breadth closes greater than previous close

coverage.Name: Breadth green candles
coverage.Rule: Fraction of authentic breadth Close>Open

coverage.Name: Late breadth confirmation
coverage.Rule: Yesterday RSI lower release or green recovery after falling bar; today >=2 breadth rising and C>=yesterday C

coverage.Name: Top thinning
coverage.Rule: New 20-bar close high; fraction of breadth lower than on previous 20-bar price peak

coverage.Name: Bullish breadth divergence
coverage.Rule: C tests/breaks prior close low (0.5% tolerance); prior low 3..20 bars ago and intervening rebound>=1%; fraction breadth higher

coverage.Name: Breadth saucer
coverage.Rule: Fraction: decline t-10 to t-5, nonnegative t-5 to t slope, no new low for last 3 bars

coverage.Name: Broad breadth impulse
coverage.Rule: Mean clipped positive daily breadth changes /10pp

coverage.Name: Nasdaq breadth leads
coverage.Rule: BN rises while fewer than 2 SP breadths rise; current observation only

coverage.Name: High B200 plateau
coverage.Rule: B200>=60; last 10-bar range<=5pp and price rises over 10 bars

coverage.Name: Weaker participation analogue
coverage.Rule: Current drawdown>=3%; compare to nearest-depth completed 20-bar drawdown episode in past 252 bars (within 2pp); positive mean breadth deterioration/20pp

coverage.Name: Candle body
coverage.Rule: Signed (C-O)/O in % divided by 2, clipped -1..1

coverage.Name: Green lower wick
coverage.Rule: C>O, L<previous L, lower wick>=40% of H-L

coverage.Name: ATR shock
coverage.Rule: clip(ATRP1 / median(previous 20 ATRP1) -1,0,1); unsigned volatility, not candle body

coverage.Name: Full upward gap
coverage.Rule: L>max High of preceding 5 bars

coverage.Name: Multi-bar impulse
coverage.Rule: 2- or 3-bar same-color run; signed total C/first O move /3%, clipped -1..1

coverage.Name: Low-breadth doji
coverage.Rule: Body<=20% range, lower wick>=40%, B50<20 and rising; flat bar =>0 (no pattern)

coverage.Name: Front contango
coverage.Rule: tanh(100*(F2/F1-1)/5); actual contracts, not 30/60 interpolation

coverage.Name: Whole VIX curve
coverage.Rule: (rising pairs-falling pairs)/pair count for actual contracts through 180 DTE

coverage.Name: Mixed curve
coverage.Rule: Front spread<0 and average of pairs after the first>=-0.5%

coverage.Name: Backwardation starts
coverage.Rule: Yesterday front>=0 and today<0, excluding front-expiry roll

coverage.Name: Contango returns
coverage.Rule: Yesterday front<=0 and today>0, excluding front-expiry roll

coverage.Name: Front expiry near
coverage.Rule: Front DTE<=3; context only

coverage.Name: VIX stress easing
coverage.Rule: Yesterday VIX>=30 and today VIX falls; raw VIX retained

coverage.Name: Zweig starts
coverage.Rule: Fraction of Working, Strong and Classic triggers today

coverage.Name: Zweig density
coverage.Rule: Working density /30; also keep Strong density and both ages

coverage.Name: Zweig modes overlap
coverage.Rule: Working and Strong densities both>0

coverage.Name: Damage during Zweig
coverage.Rule: Working density>0, >=2 breadth falling, EMA close break and broken bull order

coverage.Name: Titanic starts
coverage.Rule: Titanic today true and yesterday false

coverage.Name: Titanic persistent
coverage.Rule: Observed Titanic run>=7 (boundary choice explicitly 7)

coverage.Name: Titanic recently ended
coverage.Rule: No signal today, last ended signal within 20 bars

coverage.Name: Strong RSI and trend
coverage.Rule: At least one upper RSI (or upper release) + bull order + all slopes rising + C>=E20

coverage.Name: Recovery before RSI
coverage.Rule: Drawdown>=5%, green price, >=2 breadth rising, both RSI lower

coverage.Name: Confirmed RSI release
coverage.Rule: At least one RSI lower release or yesterday release; green price and >=2 breadth rising

coverage.Name: EMA100 bounce no saturation
coverage.Rule: Recent EMA20/50 break; closes hold E100 within 5 bars, touched within 1%, price and slow RSI rising, no lower saturation

coverage.Name: Shallow pickup
coverage.Rule: Green after 1..3 falling E20 bars and prior close below E20; held E50 throughout episode; bull order before episode; first green only

coverage.Name: Deep pickup
coverage.Rule: Up cross E20 green, past 10 bars include close below E50, all close>=E100 and low approached E100 within 1%

coverage.Name: Repeated pickup
coverage.Rule: New C05/C06 and preceding pickup 8..10 bars ago

coverage.Name: Double RSI red break
coverage.Rule: Yesterday bull order and price above E20, both RSI upper; today both release + E20 down cross + red body >2x median prior 20 bodies

coverage.Name: Fall despite contango
coverage.Rule: C<E20, positive front spread, VIX rising

coverage.Name: Recovery before contango
coverage.Rule: C02/C03 in prior 10 bars, price up, VIX down, front<0 but improving (no roll)

coverage.Name: Gap recovery complex
coverage.Rule: Full gap, at least one EMA reclaim, >=3 breadth rising and contango return

coverage.Name: Breadth bottom in stress
coverage.Rule: B08>0, drawdown>=5%, both RSI lower and front<0; green trigger kept separately

coverage.Name: Repeated RSI release
coverage.Rule: Current slow RSI lower release, previous release 5..15 bars ago with renewed saturation between; green body>=past median; signed B200 difference retained

coverage.Name: Healthy to double break
coverage.Rule: Yesterday bull order above all EMA, front>0 and Working density=30; today double EMA20/50 break and backwardation start
